data.text: Commits 1-3 landed green (606d0f0 docs revision, f85134f watch fold, aaad5b5 verb-less dispatch). Deviation from plan: the "uninitialized repo → run tuhdoo init hint" scenario doesn't exist — the daemon auto-creates the data branch on spawn (runInit is spawn+confirm), so only "not a git repo" errors, and openRepo's existing message covers it. Remaining: commit 4 (modeDetail screen: enter/esc, j/k scroll via line windowing, render via printTask from live snapshot) and commit 5 (edge-marker suffixes · N deps / · in <parent> on rows). Then push, update memory/docs? No — docs done in commit 1.
